meta.name: coding-agent-sessions
meta.description: Finds, reads, and reconstructs coding-agent sessions across Codex, Claude, OpenCode, OMO/Senpi, and other local agent logs. Use when asked to find or search past sessions, transcripts, or subagent runs, or to recover what an earlier session did.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把散落在本机的编程助手会话记录找出来,还原上一次到底做了什么
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果同时用好几个编程助手,想找回之前某次会话干了什么
copy.tagline_en: Dig up past coding-agent sessions and reconstruct what an earlier run did
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you juggle several coding agents and need to recall what a past session did

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先在你机器上搜索 Codex、Claude、OpenCode 等编码代理的本地会话记录,并把平台、会话 ID、文件路径、首末用户提示、子会话数等以 JSON 返回;需要时可读取某个会话或原始记录。
howto.when: 当你要求查找、搜索过去的会话记录、子代理运行,或想弄清某次会话做过什么时接管;没指定平台时会并行扫描所有已注册平台。

say.text: 帮我找上周那个 OpenCode bug 的会话
say.note: 会拆成多条查询词并行搜索并返回候选

say.text: 列出最近 7 天的 Codex 会话
say.note: 返回平台、路径、时间等字段的列表

say.text: 读一下这个会话,连它的子代理一起
say.note: 输出提示、事件和子会话树

howto.what_en: After install, Claude searches local logs of coding agents like Codex, Claude and OpenCode, returning JSON with platform, session ID, path, first/last user prompts and subagent counts; it can then read a session or raw transcript.
howto.when_en: Triggers on requests to find or search past sessions, transcripts or subagent runs, or to recover what an earlier session did. With no platform named, it scans all registered platforms in parallel.

say_en.text: Find my session about the OpenCode bug last week
say_en.note: Expands into several queries run in parallel

say_en.text: List Codex sessions from the last 7 days
say_en.note: Returns platform, path and time per hit

say_en.text: Read that session including its subagents
say_en.note: Shows prompts, events and the child session tree
